rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes all round and a steep fall.

drivers.seclusion: Vacant bushy block behind the kerb; houses 20 m across the road and 27 m behind. Homes within 25 m all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the kerb; room to pull in.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it; signed 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 11% grade on best section
Signed 2P daytime weekdays, resident permits excepted
Houses 8-11 m away at 11 m and 40 m along
sun_shade: Trees on the south side shade it from the south and west; open to the north sun.

best_section.where: South kerb beside the overgrown vacant block, mid-street
